retained_failures.issue: Incomplete initial clone/index and missing runtime LFS assets
retained_failures.resolution: Rebuilt index without touching source; restored missing paths; fetched runtime assets by official upstream LFS pin after GitHub LFS 404.

retained_failures.issue: Old shared submodule administration links affected during merged-checkout cleanup
retained_failures.resolution: Rebuilt missing metadata from retained exact source pins; all remaining submodule links validated; no checked-out source bytes changed.

retained_failures.issue: Legacy uiItemL call is not available in the pinned 5.4 API
retained_failures.resolution: Used supported uiItemL_ex; full source build passed.

retained_failures.issue: COPYING points to full GPL text; initial unit assertion expected full text in the pointer file
retained_failures.resolution: Verify the actual doc/license/GPL-license.txt; COPY/Authors remain byte-identical to upstream.

retained_failures.issue: First smoke image was empty because fixture parented the camera before updating its matrix
retained_failures.resolution: Update dependency graph before preserving the camera world matrix; add an independent visible-subject pixel assertion.

retained_failures.issue: Viewport diffuse color did not set the rendered Principled material
retained_failures.resolution: Set actual Principled BSDF base color explicitly; retain failed visible-color assertion.

retained_failures.issue: Visible native app inspection is blocked by locked Mac
retained_failures.resolution: Mac became available on 2026-11-04; continued with actual visible desktop checks using the computer-use tool.

retained_failures.issue: Native startup crashed in file_banners_update while the Asset Browser displayed its offline-access banner.
retained_failures.resolution: Only mark an existing FileLayout dirty; first layout allocation is already initialized dirty.
retained_failures.evidence: Native diagnostic first reproduced 2026-11-04 01:46 and again at 07:28 Asia/Shanghai.

retained_failures.issue: Native About glyph used a 128-unit canvas while Blender rasterizes icons in 1600 units. Temporary render/file titles retained Blender product names.
retained_failures.resolution: Use explicit 1600-unit glyph dimensions and product-specific temporary window titles. The user subsequently supplied the official white Finalverse base; final vector/icon/splash derive from it.

retained_failures.issue: F3 in the Asset Browser crashed reading region callbacks while constructing regionless nested menu-search layouts. A search-only guard alone did not cover nested layouts.
retained_failures.resolution: Check the region before reading its callback collection; preserve existing callback behavior for normal region-backed blocks.
retained_failures.evidence: Private native diagnostics 07:44 and 07:51; retained blender-menu-search.crash.txt.
